Find a minimal forbidden propagation set in the following exact finite graph.

All arithmetic on row labels is in the prime field GF(5000077), represented by the integers 0 through 5000076. Positions are integers modulo 32.

Displayed row labels y are a relabelling of semantic rows r. Decode and encode them by
  r = 3592409 * (y - 3501680) mod 5000077,
  y = 4462616 * r + 3501680 mod 5000077.

The row-activation polynomial is over GF(5000077). It is given as [exponent, coefficient] pairs; term order is irrelevant and omitted coefficients are zero:
  P(r) = [[0,689851], [1,3637778], [2,2891208], [3,571521], [4,100830], [5,2249819], [6,3129613], [7,1907703], [8,2301499], [9,3328259], [10,4417987], [11,2143198], [12,4561813], [13,3257183], [14,4770504], [15,2323355], [16,4370001], [17,2002769], [18,433411], [19,79942], [20,1253513], [21,4175646], [22,2643517], [23,2908959], [24,3350992], [25,320852]]
meaning P(r) is the sum of coefficient*r^exponent modulo 5000077.

For a semantic row r define
  d(r) = 1 + ((r mod 47370) mod 31),
  b(r) = (9*r + 2) mod 32.
A row-position (r,i) is active precisely when either P(r)=0, or
  (i - b(r)) mod 32 >= d(r).

Graph and propagation set. For every row r and position i there is a target vertex v(r,i). For every active (r,i) there is a zero-injection helper vertex h(r,i), adjacent to exactly v(r,i) and v(r,i+1 mod 32). The given propagation set F contains p(r,i)=(h(r,i),v(r,i)) for every active (r,i), and no other propagation.

A propagation (u,v) imposes a directed precedence arc (w,v) for every w in the closed neighbourhood N[u] except v. For W subset F, D_W is the union of all arcs imposed by propagations in W. W is a forbidden propagation set (FPS) when D_W contains a directed simple cycle. It is minimal when deleting any one propagation from W makes D_W acyclic.

Your witness is a cyclic-row descriptor [y,32,-1]. It denotes all 32 propagations p(r,i), one for each i=0,...,31, where y is the displayed label of r. The -1 records that the imposed target-vertex cycle runs from position i+1 to i. Find a descriptor whose denoted propagation set is a minimal FPS. Integers are exact; intervals and repeats are not involved.
